_note: Deterministic fallbacks (SDD §14.2). Used when grounding rejects the model's narration, and as the whole narration whenever the composer is unavailable. They read as sentences a person would write, because a fallback that reads like an error message tells the asker the system broke when in fact it declined to repeat a number it could not verify.
abstain: I can't answer that from the data Kestrel records.
breakdown: {metric} for {window}, broken down by {dimension}: {rows} rows, highest {top_key} at {top_value}.
compare: {metric} for {window} was {value}, against {compare_value} for the period before.
deny: That is outside the regions this role covers.
empty: There were no matching rows for {window}.
unverified: Answered from the tables directly rather than from a governed metric, so this number is not verified.
